inputs.description: EEG localizer and retrieval signals, stimulus categories, trial memory labels and respiration timing/phase. Respiration and remembered status are analysis stratifiers; saved classifier outputs are validation artifacts.

preprocessing.description: Author scripts remove mastoid/respiration channels, rereference, downsample, standardize and apply temporal/PCA operations differently across localizer and decision-value branches. The repository uses train-only PCA/ridge LDA and a coarser grid; native equivalence and final-paper/source differences must be resolved.

metric.description: Source classification metric is ROC AUC for object/scene discrimination (Figure 1c and Figure 3a code). Remembered-minus-not-remembered contrasts and significance are separate inferential results, not an optimization score.

aggregation.description: Figure 3a preserves participant-by-localizer-training-time-by-exhalation-aligned-retrieval-time object/scene ROC AUC separately for remembered and not-remembered trials, with a paired participant contrast. Its source-defined temporal surfaces are meaningful outputs without a mandatory scalar reducer or spatial-searchlight axis. Original ordered time support, numerical author surfaces and a predeclared source-indexed or simultaneous improvement comparison remain unbound; Figure 3c electrode/time coupling is a distinct endpoint.

full_panel.description: The scoped Figure 3a outcome is the complete participant training-time-by-exhalation-retrieval-time object/scene AUC surfaces for both memory groups, their participant contrast and source chance/null controls. Figure 3b separately requires cue-centered peak-reactivation respiratory phase, phase clustering and participant phase-concentration/memory association, with its nonremembered companion; the archived all-selected-old-trials companion is retained pending exact final-supplement mapping. Figure 3c separately requires participant/electrode/time confidence-versus-alpha/beta-power coupling, the memory-group contrast and its topographic/inferential outputs. Retain independent-localizer, cue-aligned and source power controls. No Figure 3a spatial-searchlight axis is mandated by the authenticated final article. The three declared Figure 3b coefficients remain an incomplete scalar subset; original structured axes, numerical references and complete companion/source-version reconciliation are still unresolved. Other whole-paper branches are not automatically added.
